agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 28, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Special Recognition Design Award from the San Diego Chapter of the American Institute of Architects (AIA) for Encinitas Fire Station #2
4B.
Employee of the Year Presentation by Human Resources Manager Barrett
4C.
Presentation from the San Diego County Library about the "24/7 Library-to-Go Kiosk" Offer
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 1/12/15 Joint Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-01-28 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2015-01-28 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Signs and sign hardware contract. Contact Person: Public Works Supervisor Ugrob
1) Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to approve expenditures associated with the sign and sign hardware contract with Zumar Industries, Inc. through the current contract term in an amount not to exceed $129,000; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute contract extensions with Zumar Industries, Inc., for sign and sign services, and approve expenditures associated with the contract in an amount not to exceed $140,000 annually.
2015-01-28 Item 8C - Zumar Industries, Inc. Contract Increase
8D.
Streetlight maintenance and repair services contract. Contact Person: Public Works Supervisor Ugrob
1) Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to approve expenditures associated with the streetlight maintenance and repair services contract with Clark Telecom & Electric, Inc., (CTE) through the current contract term in an amount not to exceed $150,000; and 2) Authorize the City Manager, or his designee, to execute contract extensions with CTE for streetlight maintenance and repair services and approve expenditures associated with the contract in an amount not to exceed $150,000 annually.
2015-01-28 Item 8D - Clark Telecom & Electric Contract Increase
8E.
First Amendment to the Second Amended and Restated Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement for North County Dispatch JPA Incorporating Withdrawal Liability Language. Contact Person: Fire Chief Daigle
Adopt Resolution 2015-06 approving the JPA Amendment as recommended by the JPA Board of Directors.
2015-01-28 Item 8E - Amendment to North County Dispatch JPA Agreement
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Saxony Road and Quail Gardens Drive traffic safety/calming improvements. Contact Person: Public Works Deputy Director Deane
1) Receive the staff report; 2) Direct staff to construct the Saxony Road crosswalk and associated improvements at southern location; 3) Appropriate $120,000 of Traffic Mitigation Fee funds for the construction of the Saxony Road crosswalk and associated improvements in FY 2014-15; and 4) Determine if the installation of a Senior Zone is appropriate for Saxony Road.
2015-01-28 Item 10A - Saxony Quail Gardens Traffic Calming
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-01-28 Item 15 - City Manager Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
